title: LibScript Declarative Machine Learning Workload Specification
description: Declarative ML training, inference, evaluation, multi-slice TPU, TFRC zero-cost, and 4-role GCS storage configuration.

backend.description: Default ML execution backend identifier (e.g. jax_native, pytorch_native, hf_transformers, keras_jax, maxtext).

backends.description: Ordered list of ML framework/backend matrix identifiers to evaluate across TPU or local targets.

target.description: Execution target substrate (local, tpu_vm, gcp-tpu-vm, gke-xpk, kubernetes).

model.description: Model identifier or HuggingFace/KerasHub path (e.g. google/gemma-4-E4B).

etl_command.description: Command invoked prior to training or evaluation to prepare datasets.

train_command.description: Command invoked by libscript train for model training or fine-tuning.

infer_command.description: Command invoked by libscript infer for batch or interactive inference.

serve_command.description: Command invoked by libscript serve-ml for online model serving.

eval_command.description: Command invoked by libscript eval-ml for accuracy and domain evaluation.

benchmark_command.description: Command invoked by libscript benchmark-ml for throughput and latency benchmarking.

command_matrix.description: List of templated commands evaluated across every selected backend in E4 custom matrix synthesis.

tpu_zone.description: Google Cloud zone for Cloud TPU VM provisioning (e.g. us-central2-b).

tpu_type.description: Cloud TPU accelerator SKU and slice topology (e.g. v4-8, v4-32, v5litepod-16, v6e-8).

use_queued_resource.description: Whether to provision TPU capacity via GCP Queued Resources.

num_slices.description: Number of TPU pod slices requested for multi-slice jobs.

tfrc_only.description: When true, enforces strict $0.00 TFRC zero-cost guardrails via engine/common/tfrc_guard.

tfrc_config.description: Filesystem path to the TFRC policy JSON file conforming to engine/schemas/tfrc-policy.schema.json.

fresh_vm_per_backend.description: When true, tears down and reprovisions a fresh TPU VM between backends.

gcs_storage.description: 4-role Google Cloud Storage configuration for streaming datasets, multi-host checkpoints, XLA cache, and CSI/FUSE mounts.
